== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Jin Sairus, also known as [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] Sairus, serves as the leader of the [[Wei clan]]. A powerful [[sacred artist]] following the [[Path of the White Fox]], he represents a major portion of his clan's total strength. He is viewed as an idol by younger members of the Wei, though he rarely manages daily clan affairs, leaving those responsibilities to the elders. Instead, he focuses almost exclusively on his own progression and power, only emerging from seclusion to hunt treasures, fight strong [[Remnants]], or confront rival clans. In social and political settings, he uses his high status and abilities to manipulate situations, such as using public pressure or his mastery of darkness and illusion to corner opponents. He is the grandfather of [[Wei Jin Amon]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Wei Jin Sairus is the grandfather of [[Wei Jin Amon]]. He also awarded a [[Jade{{!}}jade]] badge to [[Kelsa]] and provided [[Lindon]] with a suggestion regarding how to exit the stage without losing honor.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|As a high-status individual within the [[Wei clan]], Wei Jin Sairus serves as the [[Wei Patriarch]]. He is a [[Ruler]] on the [[Path of the White Fox]] and wears a [[Jade|jade]] scepter badge bearing the [[White Fox]] emblem upon his chest. During his time as [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]], he demonstrated the ability to warp the air around him and suggested that [[Lindon]] could exit the stage without losing honor. After awarding [[Kelsa]] a [[Jade|jade]] badge, the grandfather of [[Wei Jin Amon]] saw his body dissolve into [[Foxfire|foxfire]].}}
